title: 第十一章：总有一天
content_zh:
次日凌晨，苏晓早早醒来。
洗漱一番，穿上那身侍卫服，苏晓来到了侍卫的总部。
还没进入总部，就看到大群侍卫在总部中进出，神色匆忙。
“快，欧卡大人遇害，这件事惊动了左大臣，那位大人下令全城搜捕犯人。”
汉克神色‘悲痛’的指挥着大量侍卫，但双眼中却透出一种名为野心的东西，一副欧卡死后，他就是老大的模样。
苏晓留意到，在总部门口站着两名侍卫，正在冷眼旁观这一切，那两人正是昨晚跟在欧卡身后的侍卫，不用说，两人绝对是欧卡的亲信。
汉克这一举动，可能已经让两人起疑，但这的确是个机会，如果运作得当，汉克也有可能代替欧卡的职位。
侍卫队并不是太大的部门，除欧卡外，其他人都只是普通侍卫，欧卡其实也只是队长这种角色。
至于分队长职位，侍卫队从未有过，额外消耗资金不说，欧卡也不会允许手中的权利被分割，昨天苏晓已经领略过欧卡那嚣张的性格。
苏晓之所以杀欧卡，并不是对方在他面前摆出一副老大的姿态。
他现在很需要快速提升地位，欧克不死根本没有适合的位置。
至于王宫内部，苏晓并了解，他也不想涉足。
越是简单的计划，漏洞就越少，他只需要一个能接触到国王，并可以快速爬上去的职位。
明天就是烧毁废品终点站的日子，这种不光彩的事王宫内部当然不会亲自插手，只会派下面的人做。
苏晓调查过，王都内的警卫势力有两伙，一伙是负责王都治安的侍卫队，另一伙是负责看守城门的门卫队。
一般来说，这种事应该交由门卫队去运作，但之前在仓库中选择武器时，苏晓看到了大量炸药。
根据仓库内的蛛丝马迹，苏晓判断那些炸药都刚存入仓库不久，至于炸药的用途，也不言而喻。
想引燃规模不小的废品终点站，之凭放火明显做不到。
所以，苏晓需要侍卫首领这个职位，至于能否见到国王，就看他个人的行动了。
“汉克，发生了什么。”

正在指挥众人的汉克，偏头看向苏晓。
“老大被刺杀了，就在昨晚，这些家伙居然今早才发现，你来的正好，马上和我去见左大臣。”
苏晓心中一寒，见左大臣？这汉克可能没安好心，他昨天才成为侍卫，这无疑是一个把柄，难道想让他成为替罪羊？可能性不大。
心中已经开始思考怎么做到汉克，苏晓脸上露出笑容。
“左大臣？那种大人物要召见我？”
苏晓故作疑惑状，但双眼一直紧盯汉克。
“对，左大臣想见你，至于具体的原因我也不得而知。”
汉克露出羡慕的神色，甚至有些嫉妒。
这突如其来的好消息，让苏晓有些诧异，他与王宫高层没有任何关系，可能出现联系的东西，只有……，那封引荐信？看来那封引荐信远比他想象的重要。
跟随汉克穿过几条街区，苏晓来到一座庭院前，一栋豪华别墅出现在他视线中。
汉克有些紧张，拘谨的走上前去，两名看门的守卫拦住汉克。
“这就是大人要见的人？”
汉克连忙点头，两名守卫收走汉克的武器，至于苏晓，他所有武器都在储物空间内，守卫不可能发现。
守卫在前方引路，苏晓来到一间大厅内。
大厅内正有一家人吃早餐，一位满头白发面容严肃的老者坐在首位。
老者在看到汉克后，随意抛下手中的餐点，示意其他人退下，只剩一名精壮的男人站在老者身后。
那精壮男人给苏晓一种异常危险的感觉，虽然对方是徒手，但苏晓却留意到对方拳骨上厚厚的老茧，以及那被打平的拳骨。
这是一名体术高手，那位老者的贴身护卫。
“你是叫汉克吧，这就是那个新来的侍卫？”
老者语速平缓，神态自若，是那种位高权重之人。

“是，是的，大人。”
汉克说话都开始费力，非常促狭。
“你下去吧。”
老者可能对汉克的紧张有些不满，根本没正眼看汉克。
汉克低着头一直退到门口，之后消失在苏晓的视线中。
“我是王国的左大臣，卡洛斯献给我很多有趣的藏品，你作为他的侄子，我本应该关照一下。
可惜，卡洛斯昨天出城很不顺利，我的藏品也落空，我找不到他，当然就要找他的侄子，也就是你。”
苏晓猜出事情的大概。
卡洛斯是昨天被他杀掉的那名黑市商人，在卡洛斯死后，这位左大臣的‘供奉’落空，在找不到卡洛斯的情况下，这位左大臣就来找苏晓顶替。
那黑市商人也真是倒霉，不仅要被门卫队剥削，还要供奉这位左大臣。
看现在的情况，对方是想让他代替卡洛斯收购商品。
苏晓不了解双方的交易，如果不是对方身后有人保护，苏晓早就把这位左大臣控制。
但这种接触王国高层机会，也很难得。
“藏品没问题，叔叔的渠道我全部了解，昨天他受伤很重，正在休养，但……。”
左大臣眉头一挑，正视苏晓说道：
“能弄到我需要的藏品，条件任由你提，听说昨天你们的队长死了，事情办好，我让你做侍卫队长。”
半小时后，苏晓离开了左大臣的庭院，漫步在街道上。
事情进展的还算顺利，但左大臣提出的条件，却让苏晓有些头疼。
不仅如此，在左大臣提出条件后，轮回乐园同时出现新的任务。
【触发支线任务：左大臣的藏品】

左大臣的藏品
难度等级：lv.2。
任务简介：左大臣的藏品非常丰富，一切有价值的藏品，都会被这贪婪的老家伙看中
任务信息：杀死科尔波山的主人，并获得它的牙齿。（科尔波山的主人：海贼世界凶暴的野兽，体型巨大的猫科类动物。）
任务期限：10小时内。
任务奖励：侍卫首领身份。
失败惩罚：逐出侍卫队，并被加以莫须有的罪名通缉。
苏晓了解科尔波山的主人是什么，那只一只体型庞大的老虎，险些杀掉幼年的路飞。
长叹一声，在进入海贼世界后，他遇到的对手都太强，这让苏晓有些无奈。
总有一天，他要提着手中的长刀一路杀过去，绝不像现在这样畏首畏尾。
可海贼世界太过危险，他连拼命的资格都没有。
还是太弱小，在强大之前要学会适当的隐忍。
科尔波山的主人很强，至少不是苏晓现在能正面抗衡的，但就算再强，那也只是一只野兽而已。
正面无法抗衡，不代表苏晓不能杀掉那只老虎。

content_en:
In the early morning of the next day, Lidya Su woke up early.
After washing up and putting on the guard uniform, Su Xiao came to the guard headquarters.
Before entering the headquarters, I saw a large group of guards coming in and out of the headquarters, looking in a hurry.
"Quick, Master Oka was killed. This incident alarmed Minister Zuo, who ordered the entire city to search for the prisoner."
Hank commanded a large number of guards with a 'sad' expression, but there was something called ambition in his eyes, as if he would be the boss after Oka died.
Su Xiao noticed that there were two guards standing at the entrance of the headquarters, watching all this with cold eyes. Those two were the guards who followed Oka last night. Needless to say, they were definitely Oka's confidants.
Hank's move may have made the two of them suspicious, but this is indeed an opportunity. If it is operated properly, Hank may also replace Oka's position.
The bodyguards are not a large department. Except for Oka, everyone else is just an ordinary guard. Oka actually only plays the role of captain.
As for the position of squad leader, the Guards have never had one. Not to mention the additional consumption of funds, Oka will not allow the rights in his hands to be divided. Yesterday, Su Xiao had already experienced Ouka's arrogant character.
The reason why Su Xiao killed Ouka was not because the other party acted like a boss in front of him.
He now needs to quickly improve his status, and there is no suitable position for Oak Immortal at all.
As for the inside of the palace, Su Xiao didn't understand it, and he didn't want to get involved.
The simpler the plan, the fewer the loopholes. He only needs a position where he can reach the king and climb up quickly.
Tomorrow is the day to burn down the scrap terminal. Of course, the palace will not personally intervene in such a disgraceful thing, and will only send people below to do it.
Su Xiao has investigated and found that there are two groups of security forces in the royal capital. One group is the guards responsible for the security of the royal capital, and the other is the gate guards responsible for guarding the city gates.
Generally speaking, this kind of thing should be left to the guard team, but when selecting weapons in the warehouse, Su Xiao saw a large amount of explosives.
Based on the clues in the warehouse, Su Xiao judged that the explosives had just been stored in the warehouse. As for the purpose of the explosives, it was self-evident.
If you want to ignite a large-scale scrap terminal, it is obviously impossible to set fire to it.
Therefore, Su Xiao needs the position of leader of the guards. As for whether he can see the king, it depends on his personal actions.
"Hank, what happened."
Hank, who was directing everyone, turned his head and looked at Lidya Su.
"The boss was assassinated just last night. These guys actually found out this morning. You came just in time. Come with me to see Minister Zuo immediately."
Su Xiao felt a chill in her heart. Seeing Minister Zuo? This Hank may have bad intentions. He just became a guard yesterday. This is undoubtedly a handle. Do you want him to be a scapegoat? Not likely.
Already thinking about how to be Hank, Lidya Su had a smile on her face.
"Minister Zuo? That kind of big shot wants to summon me?"
Su Xiao pretended to be confused, but kept her eyes fixed on Hank.
"Yes, Minister Zuo wants to see you, but I don't know the specific reason."
Hank looked envious, even a little jealous.
This sudden good news made Su Xiao a little surprised. He had no relationship with the palace's senior officials. The only possible connection was... that letter of recommendation? It seemed that the letter of recommendation was more important than he thought.
Following Hank through several blocks, Su Xiao came to a courtyard, and a luxurious villa appeared in his sight.
Hank was a little nervous and walked forward cautiously, but two guards at the door stopped Hank.
"Is this the person you want to see?"
Hank nodded quickly, and the two guards took away Hank's weapons. As for Su Xiao, all his weapons were in the storage space, and the guards could not find them.
The guard led the way, and Su Xiao came to a hall.
There was a family having breakfast in the hall, and an old man with white hair and a serious face was sitting at the head.
oldAfter seeing Hank, the old man casually dropped the meal in his hand and motioned for the others to step back, leaving only a strong man standing behind the old man.
The strong man gave Su Xiao an unusually dangerous feeling. Although the opponent was using his bare hands, Su Xiao noticed the thick calluses on the opponent's fist bones and the flattened fist bones.
This is a master of physical arts and the old man's personal guard.
"Your name is Hank, is this the new guard?"
The old man spoke slowly and had a calm demeanor. He was the kind of person who held a high position.
"Yes, yes, my lord."
Hank began to struggle to speak and was very narrow-minded.
"You go down."
The old man was probably a little dissatisfied with Hank's nervousness and didn't look at Hank at all.
Hank lowered his head and retreated to the door, then disappeared from Su Xiao's sight.
"I am the left minister of the kingdom. Carlos gave me many interesting collections. As his nephew, I should have taken care of them.
Unfortunately, Carlos's trip out of town yesterday was not smooth, and my collection came to nothing. I couldn't find him, so of course I had to look for his nephew, which is you. "
Lidya Su guessed what happened.
Carlos was the black marketeer he killed yesterday. After Carlos died, the Zuo Minister's 'consecration' failed. When Carlos could not be found, the Zuo Minister came to Su Xiao to replace him.
That black marketeer was really unlucky. Not only did he have to be exploited by the guards, but he also had to worship the left minister.
Looking at the current situation, the other party wanted him to purchase goods on Carlos' behalf.
Su Xiao didn't understand the transaction between the two parties. If there wasn't someone protecting the other party, Su Xiao would have controlled the left minister long ago.
But this kind of opportunity to get in touch with the kingdom's top leaders is also rare.
"There is no problem with the collection. I know all about uncle's channels. He was seriously injured yesterday and is recuperating, but..."
Minister Zuo raised his eyebrows, looked at Su Xiao and said:
"If you can get the collection I need, the conditions are up to you. I heard that your captain died yesterday. If the matter is settled, I will let you be the captain of the guard."
Half an hour later, Su Xiao left Minister Zuo's courtyard and strolled down the street.
Things were progressing fairly smoothly, but the conditions put forward by Minister Zuo gave Su Xiao a headache.
Not only that, after Minister Zuo put forward the conditions, new tasks appeared in Samsara Paradise at the same time.
[Trigger side mission: Minister Zuo’s collection]
Collection of Minister Zuo
Difficulty level: lv.2.
Mission introduction: Minister Zuo has a very rich collection. All valuable collections will be taken care of by this greedy old guy.
Mission information: Kill the owner of Mount Colpo and obtain its teeth. (The Master of Mount Kolpo: A ferocious beast in the pirate world, a huge cat.)
Task deadline: within 10 hours.
Mission reward: identity as the leader of the guards.
Punishment for failure: Expelled from the Guards and wanted on unfounded charges.
Su Xiao understood who the owner of Mount Kolpo was, the huge tiger that almost killed the young Luffy.
With a long sigh, after entering the world of pirates, the opponents he encountered were all too strong, which made Su Xiao feel helpless.
One day, he will fight all the way with the long knife in his hand, and he will never be as timid as he is now.
But the world of pirates is too dangerous, and he is not even qualified to fight.
You are still too weak, you must learn to be patient before you become strong.
The owner of Mount Kolbo is very strong, at least not one that Su Xiao can contend with now, but no matter how strong he is, he is just a beast.
Being unable to compete head-on does not mean that Su Xiao cannot kill the tiger.
